title: Zesty Garlicky Irish Porcini Skillet
description: A hearty Irish dish featuring porcini mushrooms and score-fat, perfect for a brunch gathering, this macrobiotic-friendly recipe is garlicky and juicy, made with wholesome ingredients.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the score-fat and let it melt, then add the minced garlic and saute for 1 minute.
Add the diced onion and cook until it is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the porcini mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced potato, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Continue to cook for an additional 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the chopped parsley and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
